prompt: Create one complete, realistic, isolated coffee_table as a regular household product. Visible geometry and style: 矮款长形，弧形桌腿，边角圆润; 日式简约. Use materials ['实木'] and colors ['暖木色']. Preserve ['弧形桌腿造型，圆润边角']. Regularize temporary disorder with ['移除桌面托盘、杯子、香薰等杂物']. Simplify modeling complexity with ['简化桌面木纹细节，保留整体轮廓']: use clean broad surfaces, shallow orderly folds, separated non-intersecting parts, and avoid tangled fabric or dense tiny wrinkles. Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'bilateral', 'completionRule': '按可见侧对称补全另一侧桌腿'} and ['补全被遮挡的桌腿与桌角']. Texture rule: 清晰自然木材纹理; 延续可见木纹走向铺满桌面. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 1.10 m wide, 0.60 m deep and 0.45 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. These are category-prior estimates rather than pixel measurements. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
